candidate: H54a shared int4 row dictionary with private hard top-three routing

parent_evidence.causal_transition: H53 removes the matrix-rank ceiling and covers every weak PC above five percent, yet its two coupled factor fields recover only 7.59 percent. Move angular choice to each canonical row through a large shared target-aligned dictionary and private hard sparse routing.

scientific_question: Can a single 1024-row shared dictionary plus three hard atom choices per row cover the measured six-node top-16 MLP tangent under one percent checkpoint bytes?

frozen_inventory.pca_centering: independent mean of all 239 states for the optimistic capacity ceiling
frozen_inventory.reported_weighting: eigenvalue normalized within each node top-16 set

frozen_decoder.seed_weight: exact step-zero matrix, reproducible from matched initialization and not charged as learned state
frozen_decoder.dictionary_storage: symmetric signed int4 with one FP16 scale per atom
frozen_decoder.private_coefficients: three FP16 values per canonical row

unquantized_capacity_fit.purpose: necessary shared-dictionary capacity gate; not a deployable checkpoint
unquantized_capacity_fit.dictionary_initialization: 1024 distinct normalized target rows drawn with a deterministic seed, stratified uniformly over all node-PC targets and energy-weighted within each target
unquantized_capacity_fit.row_sampling: each update samples targets uniformly and rows proportional to squared row norm within target
unquantized_capacity_fit.dictionary_retraction: unit L2 norm per atom after every update
unquantized_capacity_fit.assignment: hard absolute-correlation top three; no soft logits
unquantized_capacity_fit.coefficient_fit: differentiable ridge solve of the selected 3x3 Gram system with ridge 1e-5
unquantized_capacity_fit.training_objective: mean squared reconstruction error of unit row directions under energy-weighted sampling
unquantized_capacity_fit.evaluation: reconstruct every row of all 96 full PCs with hard top-three selection and exact ridge coefficients, then report full-matrix squared-cosine capture

controls.fixed_initial_dictionary: the exact deterministic target-row initialization with no learned updates, evaluated with hard top-three routing
controls.top_one: the learned dictionary with one hard selected atom and exact scalar coefficient
controls.top_three: the learned dictionary and frozen candidate sparse coding
controls.utilization: atom assignment histogram, active fraction, entropy, and maximum load
controls.row_energy_strata: capture for quartiles of target row energy
controls.synthetic_own_family: known dictionary, codes, and coefficients must reconstruct at least 99.9 percent

quantized_stage_if_and_only_if_unquantiz.quantizer: symmetric per-atom signed int4 with codes in [-7,7] and FP16 mean-absolute-derived scale
quantized_stage_if_and_only_if_unquantiz.reassignment: rerun hard top-three assignment after quantization
quantized_stage_if_and_only_if_unquantiz.refinement: refit only the three FP16 row coefficients; no dense or soft assignment shadow
quantized_stage_if_and_only_if_unquantiz.required_metrics: all capacity gates plus quantization loss, exact packing, chronology, late updates, A/B common path and heldout innovation

systems_accounting.materialization: three dictionary gathers and one fused scaled row sum
systems_accounting.training_state_rule: dictionary master, gradients, optimizer moments, index/assignment workspace and coefficient solver workspace are all reported separately; soft logits are forbidden persistent state

promotion: Only a complete unquantized and int4 capacity pass authorizes chronological-late and A/B-stream representation audits. No stage directly authorizes function fitting, CE, attention, or scale-up.
failure: Close this exact 1024-atom top-three row-dictionary family without dictionary-size, sparsity, bitwidth, sampling, optimizer, step, seed, CE, or model-size sweep.
forbidden: calling the unquantized dictionary a compact result
